title: V5 Research Programme Final Freeze Forensic Checklist

checks.name: Document Synchronization
checks.evidence: All V5 core documents, runsheets, and supporting specifications verified identical in requirements, gates, and parameters; workspace docs/ and Downloads/ copies have identical SHA-256 hashes.

checks.name: Unique Experiment IDs
checks.evidence: All 22 V5 experiments mapped to unique Run IDs without collisions: Core A1-A5 (V5-S01, V5-S02, V5-S13, V5-S14/15/16, V5-S20); Biological B1-B12 (V5-S00b, V5-S03, V5-S04, V5-S05, V5-S06, V5-S09b, V5-S08, V5-S10, V5-S06b, V5-S17b, V5-S12, V5-S09); Deferred X1-X5 (V5-X01 to V5-X05).

checks.name: No-Repeat Registry Consistency
checks.evidence: 12 permanently barred historical mechanisms documented with exact failure sessions and evidence files; all 22 V5 experiments demonstrate material divergence from prior falsifications.

checks.name: Seed Policy Consistency
checks.evidence: Authoritative seed sets verified across all documents: Tier 1 single default screening uses Seed 42; Tier 2 local ablation uses Seed 42; Tier 3 multi-seed confirmation, S01 baseline, Group-DRO, and modern backbones use Seeds 42, 43, 44.

checks.name: MCID Consistency
checks.evidence: Authoritative S01 Macro-F1 improvement MCID is strictly +0.015 across all documents; Gate B degradation tolerance is strictly -0.010; no stale +0.010 improvement MCID remains.

checks.name: OOF Sample Size (N) Consistency
checks.evidence: Correctly differentiated per-fold training subset (N_train=12,235), single-fold development validation split (N_val=3,059), and complete pooled 5-fold OOF population (N=15,294 rows, 8,748 lesions across 8,734 groups), exactly verified against manifest_v4.csv and s71_plan.json.

checks.name: S01 Design & Gate Consistency
checks.evidence: S01 is unambiguously specified as Fold 0 multi-seed development screening (3 seeds: 42, 43, 44; 4.6 h runtime); evaluated under two-hurdle gate requiring 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.000 AND mean gain >= +0.015; full 5-fold OOF (N=15,294) reserved for finalists.

checks.name: Gate D Reproducibility Consistency
checks.evidence: Removed ungrounded sigma <= 0.050 hard threshold; established empirical dispersion reporting and explicit stability flag (s_seed <= 0.015 for Macro-F1); requires mean > 0, >= 2/3 seeds positive, min seed >= -0.010.

checks.name: S20 Statistical Power Correctness
checks.evidence: Exact binomial test power computed from first principles: N >= 40 independent escalating lesions provides 80.7% exact power (rejection critical value k >= 26/40, alpha = 0.0403) for H0 <= 0.50 vs H1 >= 0.70; target N >= 50 provides 85.9% power; uncorrected normal approximation (84.2% at N=35) formally corrected.

checks.name: Endpoint Definition Consistency
checks.evidence: External endpoints structured as Fixed-Sequence Hierarchical Testing: Step 1: Primary Confirmatory Endpoint (7-class Macro-F1 >= 0.7500 at alpha=0.05); Step 2: Key Secondary Confirmatory Subgroup Endpoint (under-40 escalating lesion sensitivity >= 0.700 at >= 80% non-escalating specificity, alpha=0.05).

checks.name: Runtime Arithmetic & Hardware Feasibility
checks.evidence: All timings verified: Minimum Path = 10.4 GPU hours; Conditional Expected Path = 42.8 GPU hours (5 nights of ~8.5 h); Worst-Case Path = 82.9 GPU hours; all runs fit within 8.55 GB VRAM on RTX 5050 Laptop GPU; measured vs extrapolated timings cleanly separated.

checks.name: Artifact Path Consistency
checks.evidence: All referenced artifact paths verified against filesystem: results/v4/kfold/fold_assignments.csv, results/v4/kfold/s71_plan.json, ml/data/manifest_v4.csv, results/v3/oos_probe_report.json.

checks.name: Dependency Gating Consistency
checks.evidence: Strict chronological stage execution enforced: Stage 0 (CPU) -> Stage 1 (384 control) -> Stage 2 (screening) -> Stage 3 (refinements) -> Stage 4 (Group-DRO) -> Stage 5 (backbones) -> Stage 6 (ensemble via V5-OOF-COMMON-MATRIX) -> Stage 7 (safety stack) -> Stage 8 (external read). No downstream run consumes unproduced data.

checks.name: External Cohort Lock Integrity
checks.evidence: S20 cohort is permanently locked; zero model selection, threshold tuning, or hyperparameter feedback permitted; single read; pre-registered null outcome pathway formally bound.

checks.name: Historical Invalid Result Protection
checks.evidence: Invalid ~0.993 feature probe permanently barred as in-sample leakage; valid 0.7182 probe traceable to results/v3/oos_probe_report.json; 21 images / 10 lesions caveat and 34 under-40 escalating OOF lesion limitation retained.

checks.name: Test & Reserved Split Protection
checks.evidence: Strict read locks enforced: test split receipt count <= 2, reserved split receipt count <= 8; neither cohort may be opened during V5 development, model selection, or ensembling.
